locationInfo.title: Why is a precise location important?
locationInfo.description: Indicating an exact location allows buyers near you to find your item more easily, especially on the map. This increases trust and greatly facilitates delivery organization.

mediaTips.title: Tips for great photos and videos
mediaTips.tip1: Natural Light: Prefer daylight and avoid harsh shadows for true colors.
mediaTips.tip2: Neutral Background: A simple background (a white wall, a plain sheet) will highlight your item.
mediaTips.tip3: Multiple Angles: Photograph the item from all angles (front, back, sides, inside).
mediaTips.tip4: Details and Flaws: Show close-ups of important details and don't hesitate to film any potential flaws for transparency.
mediaTips.tip5: Video in Action: If possible, show the item being used in a short video.
